label: PF Backlog 15
title: U7: single .conversations location
body: Conversations exist twice (products/.conversations and pipeline_dashboard/products/.conversations, 5 files each). Make products/.conversations canonical (core/conversation_models default), migrate unique rows, remove the duplicate dir, keep a legacy read fallback.
_note: DONE: merged duplicate conversations into products/.conversations (0 unique rows; identical copies) and removed pipeline_dashboard/products/.conversations; ConversationStore now has a read-only legacy fallback (legacy_conversations_base) used only when the canonical file is empty/missing.
